workflow_metadata.name: Dev-04 Integration Surfaces & Security Hardening
workflow_metadata.description: Implement integrations per interface contracts and harden security/compliance.

steps.description: Implement client adapters / message producers per ICDs
Add retries/circuit breakers/timeouts per resiliency policies
Create contract tests verifying shape & error conditions
Validate service contracts after integration implementation
steps.purpose: Detect contract violations introduced during integration surfaces implementation
steps.when: After integration surfaces (D5.1-D5.4), before security hardening (D6.x)
steps.enforcement: STRONGLY RECOMMENDED to fix violations before proceeding

steps.description: Map compliance requirements to code artifacts
Add input sanitization, quotas, permission scopes
Integrate audit/event logging for security actions
Run static analysis & dependency vulnerability scans
